newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: SIMEX Brent slide halts, NYMEX offers support.
newsitem.headline: SIMEX Brent slide halts, NYMEX offers support.

text.p: Brent crude futures were steady on SIMEX on Monday, indicating a temporary halt in the price slump which has taken values to nine month lows.
Psychological support on the front month at $18.00 per barrel was broken in London on Friday and prices settled at $17.68, just three cents above the intraday low.
The fall also took out an area of support between $17.75 and $18.00, which represented the bottoming of the price cycle in June last year before a rally to five-year highs of $25.06.
Front-month May was untraded on SIMEX but bid at $17.70. There was no indicated offer at midday.
Brokers said a slight rebound in NYMEX prices offered some support to SIMEX.
May NYMEX crude, trading on the after hours ACCESS system, was last traded at $19.18, up six cents from New York's close on Friday of $19.12. Volume was a light 146 lots.
